skills.name: fastapi-chameleon
skills.description: Server-rendered HTML for FastAPI using the Chameleon template language. One global_init() call plus a @template decorator turns a view that returns a dict into a rendered text/html response, and not_found() and generic_error() replace FastAPI's JSON errors with HTML pages. Use when adding fastapi-chameleon to a FastAPI app, writing or editing .pt or .html Chameleon templates (TAL, METAL, ${} syntax, not Jinja), wiring global_init() and import order, returning redirects from page views, building friendly 404 or error pages, testing decorated views with pytest, or when FastAPIChameleonException, "You must call global_init()", "Invalid return type", "Template not found", or a 500 after calling not_found() appears.
